title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind as informed by real UFO material

tellings.quote: real in Close Encounters of the Third Kind for example you have crates with TRW and locked on them

plain: Steven Spielberg's 1977 film about first contact with aliens, Close Encounters of the Third Kind, is said to have drawn on real UFO material, down to crates on screen labeled TRW and Lockheed, two big American defense and aerospace companies. Michels points this out himself, without naming a source, and links the film to the astronomer J. Allen Hynek and the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. If true, the film carried real hints about who handles UFO material.
